subject: Managed server player reporting paths and limits of trusted-count inference
method: Read-only dnlib inspection of local replica assemblies; inspected game assemblies were not executed.

scope.replica: User-provided Rust dedicated-server analysis copy, not the remote running server directory
scope.networkExperiment: No network writes, session changes or RCON commands were performed for this report.
scope.privacy: No credentials, tickets, account identifiers, player records or raw payloads were read or included.
limitations: Remote binaries, plugins, launch arguments and runtime settings are unknown.
This inventories identified managed reporting paths; it does not establish native Steam, EAC or Facepunch backend eligibility rules.
The public trusted-count generation algorithm and its ingestion sources remain unknown.

assemblies.note: This replica console dispatcher includes an Oxide hook; arbitrary remote plugin behavior is not established.

paths.source: BasePlayer.activePlayerList.Count becomes the cp tag in SteamServer.GameTags.
paths.period: ServerMgr.StartSteamServer schedules UpdateServerInformation after 2 seconds, repeating every 30 seconds.
paths.filters: Requires a valid SteamServer. The count itself has no first-PlayerTick, awake-state, per-player EAC or IP-distinct filter.
paths.limit: The native Steam SDK produces query/session behavior; this is not proof of its A2S player-count formula or the Facepunch trusted count.

paths.destination: Steam game-server authentication and user data
paths.source: Auth_Steam begins a player session, then calls UpdatePlayerSession after successful authentication; failures/cancellation end the session.
paths.period: Authentication lifecycle, not periodic PlayerTick publication.
paths.filters: Authentication success gates UpdatePlayerSession. censorplayerlist changes the chosen name, not whether the update is called.
evidence: Auth_Steam state machine 060078AF IL_0063 and IL_02D0
paths.limit: The BUpdateUserData bool result is discarded in this wrapper. No new UpdatePlayerSession call was identified in EndSleeping or the received-tick handlers.

paths.source: The Steam validation callback invokes RustPlatformHooks.AuthSessionValidated, which first calls Azure.OnSteamAuth and then ServerMgr.OnValidateAuthTicketResponse.
paths.filters: No success-only guard occurs before OnSteamAuth in this callback. The active count has no sleep, PlayerTick, per-player EAC or IP-distinct filter here.
evidence: Azure.OnSteamAuth 06009288 IL_0054 through IL_0063, submit IL_009A
paths.limit: This event can precede admission of the connecting player. Event creation and queueing do not prove upload, ingestion or use by the public trusted-count service.

paths.source: ClientReady emits OnPlayerConnected after Connected/JoinedGame and before player spawning. OnDisconnected emits OnPlayerDisconnected.
paths.fields: Connection event includes wipe/user/name/IP metadata; no actual values were inspected for this report.
paths.filters: No first-PlayerTick, awake-state or per-player EAC gate in these event methods.
paths.limit: A connect event is not a protected EAC-session result or trusted-count admission acknowledgement.

paths.source: AggregateLoop requests player position aggregation each enabled iteration and additional server/entity/item/player/team aggregates every 60 iterations.
paths.period: Loop waits 60 seconds. The every-60-iteration subset is nominally hourly and can execute on the first enabled iteration because its counter starts at zero.
filters: GameplayAnalytics globally gates the aggregate loop.
AggregatePlayers enumerates activePlayerList and skips null/destroyed objects; its count comes from the collected player list.
The inspected player count has no sleeping, first-tick, per-player EAC or IP-distinct filter.
AggregateTeams classifies a member as online only when the player exists, is not destroyed, IsConnected and is not IsSleeping.
paths.limit: The team online classification is a real sleeping-dependent analytics path. No evidence links it to the public trusted-count formula. PushServerInfo did not contain a dynamic active-player-count field in the inspected body.

paths.source: ServerMgr.Update calls PerformanceLogging.OnFrame. FlushMainThread records activePlayerList.Count as player_count.
paths.period: Default server event interval is 1 minute with gameplay analytics enabled, or 1 hour when disabled. Events then share the server table's separate batch interval.
paths.filters: Server path resets/returns if active count is zero or ServerPerformanceConVar is false. Its player count has no per-player sleep, tick, EAC or IP-distinct filter.
evidence: PerformanceLogging.FlushMainThread 060093E2 IL_0026 through IL_0047 and IL_0285 through IL_0294
paths.limit: A short quiet interval can be consistent with disabled gameplay analytics and hourly performance events; it is not proof of broken upload.

paths.destination: Facepunch/Azure tick table and separate EAC SDK calls
paths.source: FinalizeTickParallel has separate EAC analytics and Facepunch tick-analytics branches. Azure.OnPlayerTick writes detailed tick data, not an active-player count.
paths.period: Tick-driven event creation; TickLogging defaults to a 60-second table interval.
filters: EACServer.CanSendAnalytics requires server.eac_gameplay_data and a non-null EAC interface.
TickLogging registers directly with AzureBulkUploader, without the server Facepunch fallback.
EAC OnJoinGame registers a client with user/IP/platform metadata on its secure path; no IP-distinct operation appears in that method.
EAC OnFinishLoading activates networking only for an available interface and registered client handle.
evidence: EACServer.OnJoinGame 060078EF IL_007D through IL_0087 and IL_0148
paths.limit: A gameplay-data switch, registered handle, FinishLoading or tick event does not prove a valid protected EAC session. The SDK/backend may apply rules outside the inspected managed methods.

paths.source: RuntimeProfiler.SerializeCommon separately records active-player, sleeping-player and network-connection counts.
paths.period: Frame statistics are collected while enabled; profiling table upload interval defaults to 60 seconds.
paths.filters: Runtime profiling must be enabled and bulk-upload configuration available. These count fields are direct list counts, without IP grouping.
paths.limit: This optional subsystem is not established as an input to the trusted-count service.

paths.source: Started Nexus instances periodically broadcast a player manifest. ServerPlayers rebuilds an online HashSet from activePlayerList user IDs once per frame. Local zone status uses activePlayerList.Count.
paths.period: Manifest interval is controlled by ConVar.Nexus.playerManifestInterval; the remote value was not read.
paths.filters: The manifest deduplicates user IDs, not IP addresses. No sleeping or per-player EAC filter occurs in the inspected rebuilding method.
paths.limit: No connection from this coordination path to the public trusted-count endpoint has been demonstrated.

sharedServerAnalyticsPipeline.queue: EventRecord.Submit appends server records to GameplayEventsTableServer. Append queues each event without identity/IP deduplication.
sharedServerAnalyticsPipeline.registration: Analytics.StartForServer starts the manager; Azure.Initialize registers the shared server table with ServerUploader and starts aggregation.
sharedServerAnalyticsPipeline.selection: ServerUploader is FallbackUploader(AzureBulkUploader, ServerFPUploader). Resolve selects the primary when Enabled, otherwise the fallback.
availability: AzureBulkUploader is enabled by DryRun or sufficient bulk-container connection/authentication configuration.
ServerFPUploader is enabled by DryRun or the application manifest's ServerAnalytics feature.
The manager checks tables approximately every 100 ms; it accumulates enabled tables and uploads when a pending batch is due.
For a disabled uploader the manager clears both queued table events and its accumulator.
networkCalls: FPUploader Upload.MoveNext 06009363 uses HttpClient.PostAsync and EnsureSuccessStatusCode
sharedServerAnalyticsPipeline.dryRunCaveat: FPUploader Upload.MoveNext 06009363 reads DryRun at IL_027B and branches at IL_0280 directly to IL_02F2, bypassing HTTP, then increments bytesUploaded through IL_0305. UploadedSize growth and Enabled=true alone therefore do not prove network transmission.
limits: Five minutes is the local table's default batch interval, not a proven trusted-feed recomputation period or latency guarantee.
A successfully uploaded event does not demonstrate backend retention, count eligibility or trusted-feed inclusion.
No configuration values, uploader URLs or authentication material were read.

commands.name: global.serverinfo
commands.meaning: Players is activePlayerList.Count; output has aggregate server fields, not per-player records.

commands.name: analytics.stats
commands.meaning: Aggregate serialized/uploaded/queued metrics; not a per-account inclusion result.

commands.name: analytics.tablestats
commands.meaning: Tables, selected uploader, compression, intervals and serialized metrics. May initialize a diagnostic accumulator, but does not force an upload.

commands.name: analytics.uploaderstats
commands.meaning: Uploader Enabled and serialized metrics; does not itself display per-uploader successful-upload bytes.

commands.name: analytics.gameplay_analytics
commands.use: Getter only: no value or argument; registered RconOnly.

commands.name: analytics.gameplay_tick_analytics
commands.use: Getter only: no value or argument.

commands.name: analytics.performance_analytics
commands.use: Getter only: no value or argument.

commands.name: analytics.dryrun
commands.use: Getter only: no value or argument; essential for interpreting upload counters.

commands.name: server.eac_gameplay_data
commands.use: Getter only: no value or argument; not a protected-session result.

readOnlyObservation.getterEvidence: Facepunch.Console.dll Command.DefaultCall 0600003B returns at IL_0012 when HasArgs(1) is false. Internal 0600000C then reads GetOveride/get_String for variable output. The replica dispatcher also offers a pre-command Oxide hook, so unknown remote plugins remain outside this guarantee.

conclusions: Steam tags and several server analytics paths use active-player counts without requiring first PlayerTick, wakefulness, per-player EAC or IP-distinct filtering in the inspected count code.
Team analytics has an awake-state online classification; tick and EAC telemetry have their own gates. These are separate paths and are not proven trusted-count eligibility rules.
An IP field supplied to analytics or EAC is not evidence of an IP-deduplication policy. No backend policy can be inferred from absence of local grouping.
Remote configuration can suppress event generation, select a different uploader or discard queued events. Its current configuration has not been observed.
These static findings do not yet explain the independent sessions' absence from the public trusted count. Backend account/IP/EAC eligibility, ingestion and expiry remain unresolved.
